_note: Curated subset only, not exhaustive. Covers common lay-term Animalia subdivisions verified as clean EXACT matches against the GBIF Backbone Taxonomy. Anything not listed here falls through to a live species/match call. 'Reptiles' has no single class in the current backbone (2022 Catalogue of Life split retired class Reptilia into 4 classes) so the 4 entries below must be used together, as a group, to represent a 'reptiles' request - not individually. Fish are deliberately excluded - see PLANNING_INTENT_QUERY_210726.md for why.
